description: The agent must: (1) Read all architecture/design files under paystream/ to extract system-specific details (components: API Gateway, Auth Service, Payment Processor, Card Tokenization Service, Settlement Engine, Kafka, Admin Panel, Fraud Detection, etc.). (2) Produce paystream_threat_model.md using the exact Output Template from SKILL.md with all 8 required sections: Scope, Assets, Trust Boundaries, Data Flow Diagram, STRIDE Analysis, Prioritized Threats, Residual Risks, Review Schedule. (3) Build a STRIDE Analysis table covering all 6 STRIDE categories (Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, DoS, Elevation of Privilege) with at least 3 PayStream-specific components. (4) Construct an attack tree using the exact hierarchical notation from SKILL.md (├──, │, └── characters) with at least 2 levels of branching and a stated Goal. (5) Apply DREAD scoring to threats with all 5 factors (Damage, Reproducibility, Exploitability, Affected Users, Discoverability) rated 1-10 each, using the proprietary formula Sum/5 = Risk Level. (6) Include a Prioritized Threats list with [High]/[Medium]/[Low] labels and at least 3 numbered entries. (7) Include a non-empty Residual Risks section and a Review Schedule section. The key proprietary traps are: the exact DREAD Sum/5 formula, the exact tree notation characters, all 6 STRIDE categories in a table, and the 8-section Output Template structure.
